rationale: Problem: scaffold requires 1 approving review, nothing posts approvals since DEC-0284, and GitHub forbids self-approval, so a solo adopter can only merge by admin bypass. Counter: the verdict comes from the system that wrote the code, so only a human approval is independent. Survives: an unmeetable count produces admin bypass, not review; the reviewers are separate agents; teams keep 1 when humans merge and may raise it. Operator chose 2026-11-22.
